name: Blessing of Húath [Ogham]
body:
The hawthorn tree holds special significance to you for the protection it provides and its connection to the world of the fey as represented by the ogham húath.

Prerequisite(s): Ogham Connection or the Ogham-Craobh class feature.

Benefit(s): You gain a +2 insight bonus to Sense Motive skill checks when dealing with individuals of indifferent or worse attitude. If you are dealing with someone of the fey type, this bonus increases to +4. You also gain a DR 1 versus any physical attack from a fey type creature, and for every Ogham feat you possess beyond this one, the DR increases by 1 (maximum of 5).
